message:
Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /work && cp -r /gt/_work/src . && cd src && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DBUILD_CODEC=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF .. > /tmp/cmake.log 2>&1 && make -j4 opj_compress > /tmp/make.log 2>&1 && cd /work && python3 -c "
import struct
w, h = 200, 100
with open(\"/work/test.pgm\", \"wb\") as f:
    f.write(b\"P5\\n%d %d\\n255\\n\" % (w, h))
    f.write(bytes([128]) * (w*h))
print(\"PGM created\")
" && /work/src/build/bin/opj_compress -i /work/test.pgm -o /work/test2tile.j2k -t 100,100 2>&1 | tail -5 && python3 -c "
data = open(\"/work/test2tile.j2k\",\"rb\").read()
print(\"size\", len(data))
print(data.hex())
"' 2>&1 | tail -10

message.content: The build environment is ephemeral - each `build.sh` call starts fresh. The `cp -r /gt/_work/src .` copies the source, but the build artifacts from the previous call are gone. Let me build and use the encoder in a single call.
